description: This file contains unit tests for the GenerateAliasAttributesAnalyzer, which enforces the addition of [Alias] attributes to relevant Orleans-specific types and interfaces, particularly focusing on grain interfaces and serializable types. It uses Xunit testing framework and includes various test cases to verify the analyzer's behavior.

classes.name: GenerateAliasAttributesAnalyzerTest
classes.description: A test class verifying the behavior of GenerateAliasAttributesAnalyzer, including diagnostics for missing [Alias] attributes on interfaces, classes, structs, and records relevant in Orleans RPC serialization and grain interfaces.

methods.name: VerifyHasDiagnostic
methods.description: Verifies that the given code triggers the expected diagnostics from the analyzer.

methods.name: VerifyHasNoDiagnostic
methods.description: Verifies that the given code does not trigger any diagnostics from the analyzer.
